methodology_note: The review's grading model matches the snapshot and the verified-scorer code, and every replay claim I re-ran (053 user-lookup row, 054 shipping/order, 056 account_type, the gold replays for all 20) reproduces. Its product-selection reconstructions are careful and I found no wrong arithmetic. Two blind spots: (1) it did not apply calibration.md's fixed rule for after-clock data, preferring a 'natural reading' argument, which moved 072-074 off the calibrated Major; (2) it adopted a no-stacking ATM-fee convention from task data and one business doc (hunter_green_009) without checking the network-based fee definitions and the explicit stacking statements in hunter_green_010/navy_blue_009, which overstated 075 to Blocker and hid a second reading in 072-074. Minor process gap: promotion docs general_015/016 (business savings) were used in 071 but not considered in 056. None of my verdicts depends on the verified scorer's relaxations except task_053's, which fails under it because user_discoverable_tool_calls is compared exactly.
